pages.text: $(bold)Press J$() to open the Sweaty Feet config screen — in-game or from the main menu.$(br2)Left side is a collapsible category tree, right side holds the actual options: toggles, numbers and the eyedropper color picker.

If the key conflicts, the game shows a red warning and you can rebind it in vanilla key settings.$(br2)$(bold)Server config$() (level times, fungus, values) is set by the host; $(bold)client config$() (visuals, picked color) is per-player.
